notes.title: Update 0.5.8
notes.notes:
Hey there!

A couple of days ago, we dropped a new update! This one’s extra special because the Android version is now available worldwide for the first time! 🎉 Multiplayer, however, is still only available on PC - for now. Don’t worry, it’s coming to mobile eventually.

For now, let’s dive into the most noticeable change in this update: the new health system!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/b282e33bef30d41454bed171d8ccc51b95c1da61.gif

When you take damage, a health bubble will spawn. You can pick up these bubbles to restore a lost limb. You can also pick up health bubbles spawned by other players. All health bubbles are the same, so grab them while you can.

You’ll still have three health points before you die, just like before. However, when you lose a body part, you’ll start bleeding. If you don’t pick up a health bubble and patch yourself up, you’ll eventually bleed out and die. (Creepy, right?)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/2add5631c02760981c4c9a4f4d969becf00748aa.png

The more limbs you lose, the faster you’ll bleed out. So, don’t wait around - you’ve got about 10 to 20 seconds to save yourself. Keep in mind that we’re still testing this system, and it needs some polishing, so these numbers might change. Either way, it brings exciting new dynamics to the game, especially on maps like UFO and Boomchicken.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/d2cc9a80d4bd633568c4efb036a4d5817bc0813a.png

While the new health system might steal the spotlight, the biggest change behind the scenes for us has been optimization. We’ve spent months making sure Chop Chop Guys runs smoothly on mobile with a solid framerate. Our goal is to hit 60 FPS on devices like the Google Pixel 4 and similar hardware.
What does this mean for PC players? The game should now run flawlessly on the Steam Deck! 🚀 Give it a try and let us know what you think on our Discord server.

Cheers,
The Chop Chop Guys Dev Team
ːnecroheartːːnecroheartːːnecroheartː

notes.title: 0.5.5 Summer update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/fec13f8074bc0a1eafd4d313a63153f3de19d16f.jpg

Hey there! It's been a while since our last update. We know you're eagerly waiting for new content, especially new levels. And... this update doesn't include them. ːsteamfacepalmː

Wait, what?! How could we spend all this time and not make new levels?!!1 ːsteamfacepalmːːsteamfacepalmːːsteamfacepalmː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/3e651ee2c11aa95293166b2b7a4b409099fd06d7.gif

Well, we were up to all sorts of things ːchuchelsmileː

Last time, we mentioned that we were working on the Android version of the game, and we're almost done with it. We'll have a separate announcement about that soon. For now, since we're here on Steam, let's dive into what's new in version 0.5.5, which should be available to play now.

Server Update

This is probably the biggest but least noticeable change. We're temporarily moving away from dedicated game servers to a system where one player's computer acts as the server.

There are pros and cons to this. The main advantage is that the game will no longer depend on our available servers. Now, any number of people can play Chop Chop Guys at any time. The downside is that without dedicated servers, cheating might become easier. We'll mark any accounts caught cheating in our database, and before the full release, we'll wipe them. On release, we'll switch back to dedicated servers. So, cheaters will just lose all their progress. Everyone else will keep their progress and get bonus content for participating in the playtest. What content? We don't know yet. ;)

A Thousand Little Things

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/296a284d8b808121ea2cf80e9ae376b9b22a64e7.jpg

Since the last update, we've made over 500 commits (changes, fixes, new bugs) to the project repository. Listing them all would be impossible. Just know that the game is now a little better, a little faster, and a little prettier. Our programming machine Alex (also known as "koban") has been fixing and improving things day and night. No one remembers what exactly anymore, so just launch the game and see for yourself.

Playtest

Today, we opened access to the game for everyone who requested it earlier. This playtest will run indefinitely. At least, we don't plan to turn it off in the next month or two. We'll be fixing bugs and adding new features directly to the live game. You can report bugs on our Discord server. We read all messages almost every day.

That's all for now. See you in the game!

--
Chop Chop Guys
Dev Team

notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.notes:
Did you notice the new screenshot on the Chop Chop Guys homepage? Something beautiful has appeared there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/8762eec9adfd0fa4c00b9fd9c23096f1de5477e8.jpg

It's a completely updated Darts level. Like Hamlet, it has changed both externally and internally. And we think it's for the better. If you want to try everything with your own hands, then hurry up and launch Chop Chop Guys on Steam. The fresh version 0.5.3 with the updated level is already available for testing.

And below, I'll tell you a bit more about the new features at the level.

ːsummer2021actionː The first and most noticeable thing is already visible in the screenshot. Real art has appeared on the level!

ːsummer2021actionː  See that strange robot holding a bouncer in the screenshot? Now, it will randomly turn it at random times.

ːsummer2021actionː  And to make aiming more convenient, a trajectory will now be drawn in flight, showing where Bob will fly after dashing in the air.

ːsummer2021actionː  Hitting a hundred now accumulates a Streak. You can accumulate up to x5. The streak disappears if you hit anywhere other than 100.

ːsummer2021actionː And lastly, take a closer look at these balls around the target. Maybe they're not just there for no reason?

Be sure to write in the comments what you think about the updates on this level!

–

notes.title: Version 0.5.2
notes.notes:
A Whole New Look for the Nuclear Pillars Map

https://i.imgur.com/WylfSrY.gif
New Gameplay Rules for Color Floor
We've identified an issue with the Color Floor gameplay where your final position is mostly determined by the last few seconds. We're addressing this by introducing two new features:
Tiles with Bonus Points

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/6e726961b958211926342a8108a4e417832fdd43.jpg
Points Resolution Stages
Instead of your final points being equal to the number of colored tiles at the end of the round, we now calculate points three times during the round, at the end of each progress bar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/e8ef00773ff3fbd0e40dc0569a393590f356e72b.jpg
Darts
We've changed the target points grading to emphasize precision. This adjustment is an intermediate step before a more significant gameplay and aesthetic overhaul in the next update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/a95a81fe69c23d1a93ab77f1e540e670ed142536.jpg
Kill Bob Kill
The spawn point is now randomized after death, reducing the impact of spawn location on your chances of winning.
We've enhanced bot behavior, making them smarter—prepare accordingly!
A minor fix has been implemented for shooting direction.

Boomchicken
The rate of exploding egg spawns now varies based on the number of players remaining on the map, ensuring a fairer experience towards the round's end.

UFO
Fixed an issue where players could fly away when spawned inside the beam.

Bobsleigh
Fixed missing "blood" decals on the Bobsleigh map and in certain areas of other maps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/3ca87cc88c18dcc14f50008165063c333a045fc1.jpg
Run Bob Run
Improved bot behavior to reduce instances of getting stuck on the map.

Other Fixes and Improvements
Enhanced visual quality in close-up camera scenarios, allowing characters and level geometry to softly fade in and out.

https://i.imgur.com/fu1fNyO.gif

     Dismemberment now reflects the location of damage more accurately. For example, stepping on floor spikes will result in legs being torn off first.
     Slightly reduced loading times between map transitions.
     Fixed initial character rotation.
     Addressed some action inconsistencies following the 'Esc' menu.
     Changed the initial tiles animation on the Volcano map.
     Added a 'Bad Connection' indicator for poor internet connections.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/f2d90035121b6a98f8c3f57b1b3cd11caffa5bae.jpg
     Introduced FPS and ping indicators.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/1d23b26fb4ce7fd5bf6b60a1dc9f571a821dc79e.jpg
     The state of show/hide nicknames now persists between levels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/332a192043a88efd5cb0f8a2e22f254f24cd9485.jpg
     Added the ability to rotate your character in the main menu using the mouse, in addition to A/D or the gamepad stick.
     Fixed visible gaps between character parts in certain situations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/bc7e5b737ee8b037d6884b5cc5f7ca5ed039ba5d.jpg
     Increased the internal physics tick rate to reduce ragdoll jitteriness.
     Fixed issues with passing through bouncers at high speeds.
     Enabled emotes during the intro countdown phase.
     Camera now properly resets on respawn.

UI Fixes

 Removed irrelevant qualified/eliminated counters for modes where they don't apply.
 Corrected overlapping UI elements.
 Fixed issues with item selection in the game shop not being centered.
 Implemented minor typo and font corrections.

notes.title: August update
notes.notes:
Hey there! It's Minsky from Chop Chop Guys. It's been a while since our last playtest, and now it's time to share the latest updates about the development of our game.

During this time, our development team has welcomed some new faces. We've got Alex, a talented Unreal programmer from Germany, Daniel, an artist-designer from Kazakhstan, and a trio of awesome backend programmers – Karina, George, and Sergey. With these new additions, we'll be able to create bugs three times faster and make them look beautiful, thanks to the skills of a true artist. Cheers to that!

We haven't officially announced this yet, so please don't consider this paragraph an official announcement, but we've started experimenting with a mobile version of the game. Besides the opportunity to play on the go, this has actually benefited the PC version due to the optimization work we've done. Our goal is to achieve a solid 60fps at 1080p resolution on any device.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/9aa17aaaa91b70ba07a20cc1604f8ac83759e46c.jpg

Moving on, we've begun enhancing what's commonly known as the meta-game. No, it's not about the metaverse ;) It's all about what happens beyond the core gameplay – when you're navigating through levels, dodging dangerous traps, or outplaying other gamers. There are two specific things we're currently working on: a costume store and a battle pass. If you've joined our previous playtests, you've probably gotten lost in the customization window. Well, we're revamping that window to make it user-friendly and visually appealing. It will be split into two separate interfaces – one for buying costumes and another for your inventory, where you can deck out your character. The battle pass mechanics will act as a progress indicator in the game. At the end of your gaming session, you'll earn experience and J-Cash. Experience leads to levels, which unlock new costumes in the battle pass, and you can spend J-Cash on special items in the store.

Speaking of gaming events, you might have noticed pictures from the Gamescom on our Twitter. Yep! Last week, we showcased Chop Chop Guys at one of the biggest video game exhibitions, and countless people got their hands on it! Special thanks to the Polish Indie Booth, under which the Chop Chop Guys stand was set up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/616336a7d37f17c32bb5798ab2d0fc2f9578aa3c.jpg

There are two more interesting points related to the gaming expo. You're probably familiar with age ratings like ESRB and PEGI for video games. Well, in Germany, where Gamescom took place, they have their own stricter rating system called USK. If your game doesn't fall under the 16+ category, you can only show it in a closed area or cover it with ominous opaque curtains. Since we couldn't rent an entire space and wanted to showcase Chop Chop Guys to as many players as possible, we took a daring step and changed all the blood in the game to purple. We want to hear from you about how this change has impacted the game. So, here's the deal...

We've launched a demo version! Yep, no need to wait for the playtest – you can try the game out anytime now. The demo version has just one limitation for now – multiplayer won't be available. That's why we'll continue to run playtests, so you can team up with your buddies or play with random folks from the internet. We'll let you know separately when the next playtest is happening. Stay tuned!

–
Chop Chop Guys
Dev Team
